component.name: CIT Voice Studio
component.summary: Vietnamese text-to-speech and voice cloning, offline

description.p: CIT Voice Studio turns Vietnamese text into natural speech and clones a voice from a short sample. It is built on VieNeu-TTS and runs entirely on your computer: models are included, no Internet connection is needed, and your text and audio never leave the machine.

ul.li: 25 built-in Vietnamese voices, emotion and pause tags
Voice cloning from a 3-8 second sample
Optional foreign-language voices, downloaded on demand (Supertonic 3, Kokoro)
Long texts, subtitles (SRT), batch generation and podcasts
Runs on the CPU; optional NVIDIA GPU support
